artworks.title: Colossal Statue of the Apennines
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stone statue in a forested area. The statue resembles a figure emerging from rocky formations with water cascading down like a waterfall from its body. The image captures the detailing of the stone structure and the dense forest surrounding it, with tall, narrow trees framing the scene. To the right, a stone balustrade runs alongside a pool of water, leading the eye into the background, which includes architectural elements like a pathway and smaller sculptural features. The atmosphere is serene and timeless, blending nature with human artistry.

artworks.title: Fighting Beggars
artworks.description: This drawing features two figures and a dog engaged in a struggle. One figure is holding a stick while grappling with the other, who appears distressed. The scene is dynamic and emotional, with strong lines and high contrast. The presence of the dog adds to the chaotic nature of the composition.

artworks.title: Standing Figure [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a person with curly hair, wearing ornate clothing and holding a long pole. The person is standing with one arm raised and the other arm at their side, with a slight curve in their stance. A hat with a feather is on their head. The background is plain and the artist's signature, "Bellange f," is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Figures on Horseback [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mounted figures and sketchy faces. The drawing features two central figures riding horses in an animated posture. The individuals are wearing ornate hats or helmets, and the horses are drawn with expressive lines. To the left of the central figures, there are loosely sketched faces. The use of flowing lines and shading gives the image a sense of energy.

artworks.title: La Promenade
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 19.7 x 23.1 cm (7 3/4 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two of them are depicted from the midsection upwards. The person on the far left is wearing a dark coat and a black hat, with most of the hair covered. Beside this person is another character wearing a dark hat that casts a shadow over the eyes, along with a white garment under a dark cloak-like outerwear. To the right, a third person’s upper body is shown, facing towards the other two. This person has orange or blond hair, styled close to the head and is wearing a red hat and a cloak or coat in a purple hue. The background features tall trees and a pale green landscape, suggesting an outdoor setting like a park or forest. Two shadowy figures are in the distance amongst the trees, giving depth to the scene. The edges of the image are uneven, framing the figures within a softly colored and sketched surrounding.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental frame surrounding a central text in Latin. The engravings feature classical and biblical iconography including figures at the top corners, musical instruments, pastoral elements, scholars with a book and a bull, a woman with a lamb, friezes, and swags. Central and above and below the main text are decorative arrangements of fruits, flowers, and agricultural produce. The drawing is monochrome, emphasizing fine lines and intricate patterns.

artworks.title: The Angel Telling Joseph to Flee and the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image displays a scene with a wide expanse of activity viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon line is high in the composition, showing a village, mountains, intricate architectural elements, and landscape with detailed line work typical of etching techniques. The color palette is black and white. Close to us on the left are figures and animals under a roof structure, with a tree and a bird. In the distance on the right, figures traverse a path bordered by trees and buildings, suggesting a narrative flow moving across the landscape.

artworks.title: Jesus Calling the Apostles Among the Fishermen
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a port city and coastline with sailing ships on the horizon. In the foreground, fishermen are handling their catch, boats are on the water, and a robed figure is present. An architectural fortress is on the left, and a larger city can be seen in the distance. The etching uses fine, intricate brushstrokes and cross-hatching for texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette of brown and gray.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Sower
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with trees in the center, hills in the distance, small buildings scattered on the horizon, a cloudy sky, and a rider on a horse emblem. A man is depicted walking in an agricultural setting with birds nearby, leading to various buildings including a church and a castle-like structure. The scene is intricately drawn with fine lines, creating texture and depth in a primarily monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Two Sons and the Unjust Husbandmen
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricately etched scene showing a group of robed figures engaged in discussion. In the background, there is an expansive landscape with hills, mountains, a village, and fortified buildings. The etching technique uses fine lines to create textures and tones. In the sky, there is an image of a lamb or goat surrounded by clouds. The color palette is sepia-toned, enhancing the historical mood. The land and river are busy with ships, laborers, and agricultural activities. The river flows into the mountains in the far distance.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with five figures near a well, surrounded by lush trees. In the distance, there are rolling hills, paths, trees, and a village with towers and spires. The sky features clouds and a group of figures. The artwork is in grayscale with detailed line work, resembling a traditional etching.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Rich Fool
artworks.description: This print shows a vast landscape with various buildings and trees below a high horizon line. In the bottom right corner, there are four men in robes, one with his arm outstretched. On the left is a man sitting below a tree and workers on a rooftop. In the bottom left corner are animals such as pigs, birds, and a dog, near an opening in another building. In the distance there are more people working the land or walking across a winding path. There are more buildings, including small houses, bridges, towers, and what looks like a castle on a hill on the right. The sun radiates beams across the sky, and the outline of a lobster or similar animal is inside it. At the bottom of the print are some lines of text.

artworks.title: The Good Shepherd
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated point of view of a man tending to sheep near a rustic building, with sheep nearby. In the distance, there is a village with buildings, pointed roofs, and a tall spire. The image is created with intricate lines, likely using an engraving technique, portraying detailed foliage and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray. In the sky, there are clouds and a creature perched on the moon.

artworks.title: The Plucking of Ears of Corn on Sabbath Day
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a rural scene with a horizon featuring a town, hills, and a fortress. The sky has swirling clouds. The detailed engraving features fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The image is in black and white, with figures conversing under trees and agricultural activities in the distance. The background includes houses, fences, and a winding river.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree
artworks.description: This print displays a rural scene with a medieval town or village seen from a high vantage point. In the center, there is a castle with turrets surrounded by buildings with thatched roofs. The horizon line is in the upper third of the image, showing more buildings and trees fading into distant hills and a body of water with the faint outlines of ships. At the bottom, people are shown engaging in activities like picking fruit and conversing around a tall tree on the left. There are several ladders propped against the tree, and piles of round fruit below it. In the distance, there are other trees with ladders against them. In the sky above, a set of scales is depicted in a small circle.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Unjust Husbandmen
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, extending to distant mountains and a shoreline. The artwork features detailed line work with cross-hatching and stippling for texture and shading. The palette is monochromatic with shades of black, gray, and white. Figures and animals engage in activities, with a village and various buildings in the background. Fields, trees, and mountains are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Kingdom of Heaven
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape with an elevated view of a town scene. The horizon shows towers, buildings, and a winding river. Smoke rises from some parts of the town. The scene is created using precise lines, resembling engraving or etching. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of gray. In the foreground, there are figures near a grand building with ornate architecture. The town is filled with more buildings and figures, suggesting a bustling historical setting.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Joseph at the Inn
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated point of view, displaying figures, buildings, and activities in a town. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with a sky featuring clouds and a symbol in a radiant disk. The architectural structures include medieval-style buildings with steep roofs. In the foreground, three figures in Eastern attire interact with a resident at the entrance of a thatch-roofed building, next to a donkey with a bundle. The etching style features fine lines and hatched shading, portraying textures and details. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or gray tones. People in the town are engaged in various activities around a central well, creating a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Milkmaid
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with human and animal activity. A man tends to goats while another person milks a cow. Various animals like cows, goats, and sheep are present. In the background, there are city-like structures and a tall spire. The land features rolling hills, buildings, and rocky outcrops. The sky is filled with detailed cloud formations and dynamic lines. The artwork is in black and white, emphasizing the busy yet peaceful countryside with intricate textures. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing different textures with precise line work.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with rolling hills, trees, and rocky outcrops. In the foreground, there are large feline animals resting under trees with detailed foliage. A rocky path leads towards a figure in the middle ground gesturing towards something out of view. The artwork features fine linework creating texture and depth, resembling detailed engravings. The color scheme is monochromatic, using only black and white to highlight the linework and textures.

artworks.title: The Birth of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical interior scene with classical architectural elements. The image depicts an intricately detailed interior, possibly a temple or palace, featuring grand architectural elements such as columns and arches. There are numerous figures, statues, and reliefs present in the scene. At the forefront, there is a group of figures in dynamic poses, and in the background, more figures are visible. The architecture includes niches holding classical sculptures, and there are ornate decorative details throughout. The scene is carefully shaded and cross-hatched, giving depth and dimension to the figures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Love
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical scene with various figures, a sun deity, and a chariot in a natural setting. The scene includes a gathering of nude figures in various poses, some standing and some reclining near a body of water. In the background, a small village with houses and trees can be seen, leading up to a hill. Above the scene, a figure rides a chariot pulled by horses across the clouds. The figures are depicted amidst lush trees and rocks.

artworks.title: The Large Rustic Wedding Feast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene. The composition features numerous individuals engaged in a gathering beneath large trees. The central focus is on a crowded table where people are passing around jugs and dishes. Surrounding the table, groups of people are interacting in various ways. In the background, there is activity near rustic buildings, with smoke rising. The drawing depicts detailed foliage, textures on clothing, and gives an impression of a traditional village or country fair, capturing a moment of communal enjoyment and celebration.

artworks.title: Die Blau Schuyte (The Blue Boat)
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Hieronymus Bosch
